graveyardtraveler61.m: South of the Duleian road, close to Fallhaven.

r: I opened that chest and got a powerful sword.

graveyardtraveler_10.m: Hey, did you try to open that treasure chest?

graveyardtraveler_20.m: That chest is something of a local legend. Been there for generations. They say it is sealed with magic and can only be opened with a special key, which hangs on the neck of one of the undead that roam in a cemetery directly south of here.
r: Killing the undead is my specialty.
Undead? I would love to hear the rest of your story but I am on a mission to find my brother.

graveyardtraveler_30.m: You don't think someone has already tried? It's a treasure chest ... left outside ... in plain view ... unguarded.

graveyardtraveler_40.m: Listen kid. A hundred 'adventurers' before you have tried and failed to open that chest. The problem isn't killing some undead. It's getting into the cemetery, because it's protected by a magical barrier that prevents anyone from entering.
r: Interesting. Is there anything else you can tell me about the chest or cemetery?

graveyardtraveler_50.m: That is all I know ... Come to think of it ... Hagale from the Wood Settlement was out here a few weeks ago asking about the chest. Something about him struck me as odd. It was as if he was in a trance.

graveyardtraveler_60.m: Maybe he knows more. You should give him a visit.

graveyardtraveler_99.m: I should not have doubted you. Well done.

graveyard_quest.10: I stumbled across a treasure chest in a clearing south of the Waterway house but the chest is protected by some form of magic and cannot be opened.
graveyard_quest.20: I encountered a traveler a short distance from the treasure chest. He told me there is a legend that the key to the chest is held by one of the undead that roam the cemetery to the south of the chest. However, the entrance to the cemetery is sealed by a magical force.
graveyard_quest.30: The traveler told me that Hagale in the Wood settlement might know how to enter the cemetery.
graveyard_quest.35: I went to the Wood settlement and found Hagale. He was a drunk mess and would not speak to me unless I brought him two Lowyna's special brew.
graveyard_quest.40: Hagale said that the entrance to the cemetery was also sealed with magic to safeguard the key to the chest. The seal can only be broken by defeating the undead monster. However, Hagale found an ancient text that allows the holder to temporarily enter the cemetery. Hagale gave me the text.
graveyard_quest.50: I returned to the cemetery and was able to enter it using the ancient text just as Hagale had claimed.
graveyard_quest.60: I hacked through a horde of undead until I encountered one wearing a key.
graveyard_quest.70: I killed the undead and took the key.
graveyard_quest.80: I opened the chest, which contained a powerful sword. Next time I'm in the Wood settlement I should see if Hagale is still around.
graveyard_quest.90: Hagale tried to rob me and take the sword, but I killed him and took it back.
graveyard_quest.95: Hagale tried to rob me and take the sword. He lost his wife and daughter and wasn't thinking straight. I gave him the sword without a fight.
graveyard_quest.100: Hagale wanted some of the gold I got from selling the sword. It seemed fair to give him a share.
graveyard_quest.105: Hagale tried to rob me of the gold I got from selling the sword. I had no choice but to kill him.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
